title: Influence is bounded by one
statement:
Let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be a Boolean function taking values in $\{-1, 1\}$, and let $i$ be one of its $n$ coordinates. Then the influence of coordinate $i$ on $f$ satisfies
\[
  \mathrm{Inf}_i[f] \;=\; \E\!\left[\frac{(f(x)-f(x^i))^2}{4}\right] \;\le\; 1,
\]
where $x^i$ denotes the point obtained from $x$ by flipping its $i$-th coordinate and the expectation is taken under the uniform measure on $\{0,1\}^n$.
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function of arity n
i is a coordinate (element of Fin n)
replaced:
For any $\pm 1$-valued function and any coordinate $i$,
$\mathrm{Inf}_i[f] \le 1$.
